description: This file implements AES-XTS encryption mode functions, including encryption, key initialization, control operations, and cipher structure definitions, based on OpenSSL and BoringSSL code.

methods.name: CRYPTO_xts128_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES-XTS encryption or decryption on input data.

methods.name: aes_xts_init_key
methods.description: Initializes the AES-XTS key structure with provided key and IV.

methods.name: aes_xts_cipher
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption using AES-XTS mode.

methods.name: aes_xts_ctrl
methods.description: Handles control operations for AES-XTS cipher context.

methods.name: EVP_aes_256_xts
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the EVP_CIPHER structure for AES-256-XTS.
